🎪 THE CARNIVAL SCHEDULE IS HERE! 🎠

We’ve got a full day of fun planned for the whole family! From the Petting Zoo & Pony Rides to superheroes, face painting, balloon twisting and more, there’s something happening all day long! 🐴🎈🎨🦸‍♂️

And don’t miss our special events:
🐾 4:00 PM – Animal Show
✨ 6:45 PM – Jannah’s Family
🎤 8:30 PM – Live Nasheeds ft. ILYAS MAO!!!

📅 Saturday, August 29 (12PM-10PM)
📍 Islamic Society of Markham

Save the schedule, send it to the family, and we’ll see you at the Carnival! 💚
location: 2900 Denison St, Markham, ON L3S 4J8, Canada
